create_population: create a Population instance with policies, names_by_role, and roles for scenario simulation
build_population_observables: build PopulationObservables to subscribe to names, actions, and timesteps emitted by a Population
test_population_reset: test the Population reset method to resample policy names and rebuild step functions
run_population_step: run the Population send_timestep and await_action cycle for asynchronous bot action processing
review_population_close: review the Population close method to shutdown executors, policies, and complete observables
